note: Glossify Commerce provides the glossify_commerce_product text-format filter ('Glossify: Tooltips with commerce product'), a GlossifyBase subclass that turns published Commerce product titles into links/tooltips (tooltip text = product body). Requires Drupal Commerce (commerce_product). Its settings keys are UN-prefixed: case_sensitivity, first_only, ignore_tags, glossify_type (tooltips|links|tooltips_links), tooltip_truncate, bundles (source product types, ;-joined, required when enabled), urlpattern (default /product/[id]), synonyms_field. Query tag glossify_commerce_product_tooltip. Config lives in filter.format.<format> -> filters.glossify_commerce_product.settings. Trivial-submodule tiers (3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard), config-based (no product fixtures needed - the site has no commerce store, and drush rendering hits a core theme-registry limit on this shared site). Fixtures create/tear down their own gl_com_* text formats and reference the existing 'default' product type.

evals.prompt: What does the glossify_commerce module add, what does it auto-link, and what does it require?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'Glossify: Tooltips with commerce product' filter (id glossify_commerce_product), which turns published Commerce product titles of selected product types into links to those products and/or tooltips (from the product body). It requires Drupal Commerce (commerce_product).

evals.prompt: The glossify_commerce filter's setting keys differ from the node/taxonomy Glossify filters. Which setting selects the source product types, and what is the default URL pattern?
evals.expected_output: Unlike the node/taxonomy filters, glossify_commerce's keys are un-prefixed: 'bundles' selects the source product types (required when enabled) and 'urlpattern' defaults to /product/[id]. (Others: case_sensitivity, first_only, glossify_type, tooltip_truncate, synonyms_field.)

evals.prompt: Which query tag does the glossify_commerce filter add so other modules can alter which products are used as the term source?
evals.expected_output: The product-source query is tagged glossify_commerce_product_tooltip, alterable via hook_query_glossify_commerce_product_tooltip_alter().

evals.prompt: The text format 'gl_com_known' has the glossify_commerce_product filter enabled. Inspect its configuration and report which product type is the source and the URL pattern the links use.
evals.expected_output: The glossify_commerce_product filter on gl_com_known has bundles = 'default' and urlpattern = '/shop/[id]' (glossify_type links). Read via drush cget filter.format.gl_com_known filters.glossify_commerce_product.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a text format 'gl_com_build'. Using the glossify_commerce module, configure it so that titles of 'default' Commerce products are automatically turned into links to those products in text using this format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the glossify_commerce_product filter on filter.format.gl_com_build with glossify_type = 'links' (or tooltips_links) and bundles including 'default' (default urlpattern /product/[id]).
